Instead of the usual royal palace, the Prince and Princess of Wales engaged in the rich traditions of the vibrant city, getting to the spirit of desi cricket and chai, and were seen celebrating the artistic skills of India at large.

stories.title: Fadnavis promises quick crash probe, as Rohit Pawar alleges cover-up
stories.summary: MUMBAI/ PUNE: “I have requested the Union home minister to personally intervene to ensure that the investigations into the aircraft crash (which killed Ajit Pawar) are completed and the findings released without further delay. He has assured me that he will look into it,” Fadnavis said while speaking at a gathering after unveiling the former deputy chief minister’s bust at the Pune zilla parishad premises on Monday afternoon.

stories.title: Jay Shah re-elected unopposed as ICC chair after board clears way for bigger IPL
stories.summary: Jay Shah has been re-elected unopposed as chair of the International Cricket Council after a board meeting in Bali that has also paved the way for the expansion of the Indian Premier League.

stories.title: England stun Spain 3-2 to end record unbeaten streak
stories.summary: England snapped world champions Spain's record unbeaten run with a 3-2 victory in Madrid on Sunday (November 16, 2026) to clinch the top spot in Nations League group A3. Goals from Harry Kane, Ezri Konsa and Ben White inflicted La Roja's first loss in a competitive game since March 2023, after 44 without defeat.

stories.title: Football friendly: New Zealand thrash India again, win 3-0
stories.summary: Finn Surman (22nd min), James McGarry (40th min) and skipper Chris Wood (44th min) scored once each in the opening half as India’s defensive frailties were exposed by the hosts. India suffered a 0-3 defeat against New Zealand in a football friendly here on Sunday, conceding all three goals in the first half.

stories.title: Why Sooryavanshi missed Bihar's second SMAT match after historic captaincy debut
stories.summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi captained Bihar in one match before joining India A for the Rising Stars Asia Cup. His departure meant Suraj Kashyap took over and led the team to victory against Railways. Sooryavanshi made history as the youngest captain in T20 cricket during his brief tenure. Bihar's win showcased their resilience and ability to perform without their young captain.

stories.title: Campion, Cathedral Register Big Wins In MSSA U-12 Football
stories.summary: Campion School (Cooperage) and Cathedral and John Connon School produced impressive performances in the boys' Under-12 Division I matches of the Mumbai Schools Sports Association (MSSA) inter-school football tournament at the MSSA ground on Monday. Campion registered the biggest victory of the day, thrashing St Joseph's A (Wadala) 7-0, while Cathedral and John Connon enjoyed a successful outing with two convincing victories.

stories.title: 82 after 60! 'Hurt' Suryakumar Yadav makes another strong statement in SMAT
stories.summary: Suryakumar Yadav scored a quick 82 runs in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, leading Mumbai to victory over Gujarat. This performance followed his earlier 60 runs against Hyderabad, demonstrating his outstanding form. After being excluded from the Indian squad, Suryakumar expressed determination to regain his place on the team.

stories.title: ‘Sitaram, Sitaram’: Sehwag, Lakshya relive the nerve-wracking India-Pakistan final
stories.summary: India's Under-19 squad claimed a spectacular victory against Pakistan in the Asia Cup final, embodying the spirit of resilience. Aaryavir Sehwag, though injured, scored a remarkable 58 runs, while captain Lakshya Raichandani marshaled his team effectively. The gripping chase culminated with Ulva striking a boundary on the final delivery, demonstrating the team's exceptional composure in high-pressure moments.

stories.title: Shah Rukh Khan to appear on the finale episode of 'Koffee With Karan 9'?
stories.summary: The final season of 'Koffee With Karan' is turning out to be an emotional one for host Karan Johar, as the popular celebrity chat show prepares to sign off after a 22-year run. As reported by Variety India, Shah Rukh will not be part of the entire episode but will join Karan on the Koffee couch for a brief appearance.

stories.title: What could the polar vortex mean for winter?
stories.summary: The polar vortex can refer to two different weather systems: the stratospheric polar vortex and the tropospheric polar vortex. Of current interest is the stratospheric one, a ring of strong west-to-east winds that circles and helps trap extremely cold air above the Arctic, around 10 to 50 km above the Earth’s surface.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan: What makes a storm severe, very severe or super cyclonic? IMD's classifications explained
stories.summary: What do these classifications mean, and how does the IMD determine a cyclone's intensity? Cyclonic disturbances are classified based on the maximum sustained wind speed around their centre. As per the weather body, the stronger the winds, the higher the category assigned to the weather system. The department measures sustained wind speed as an average over three minutes, rather than using short-lived, stronger gusts.

stories.title: India made chips at a Mohali plant in 1980s. A fire destroyed its production lines | HT Explainers
stories.summary: More than four decades before India’s first large-scale chip factory is expected to open in 2028, a state-run plant – the Semiconductor Complex Limited (SCL) at Mohali in Punjab – was already making chips, until a fire in 1989 destroyed its production lines. Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026, external affairs minister S Jaishankar recalled India’s early semiconductor manufacturing efforts, saying the country had had semiconductor plants decades ago.

stories.title: Zuckerberg Faces New $900 Million Nightmare: Why Italy Is Taking On Meta | Explained
stories.summary: The Italian Data Protection Authority has imposed an $887 million penalty on Meta for accessing photographs, videos and related metadata stored on Android users’ phones without explicit consent. Around 20 million Italian Android users are estimated to have been affected. At the centre is Facebook’s “Gallery Suggestions” feature, which suggests phone photos and videos for posts.

stories.title: Who Is Nikhil Gupta? The Man Who Admitted Role In Plot To Kill Khalistani Separatist Gurpatwant Pannun
stories.summary: Nikhil Gupta, an Indian national who has pleaded guilty to his role in a foiled murder-for-hire plot targeting Sikh separatist leader Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in the United States, is at the centre of a high-profile criminal case that has drawn international attention and strained diplomatic ties between New Delhi and Washington.

stories.title: Gratuity formula explained: Who is eligible? We calculate how much you earn for 5, 10, and 15 years of service
stories.summary: With the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC) in its consultation stage, a number of prominent unions have made a case for increase in gratuity limits besides other pension and salary reforms with view to improve livelihood of central government employees and pensioners. Notably, the National Council–Joint Consultative Machinery (NC-JCM) and the All India Defence Employees Federation ( AIDEF ) have proposed higher gratuity ceiling and revised retirement benefits among other demands.

stories.title: Why did Diljit's Indore concert spark controversy ?
stories.summary: Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh quoted poet Rahat Indori’s famous line, ‘Kisi ke baap ka Hindostan thodi hai’, during his concert in Madhya Pradesh’s Indore on November 15. The performance came amid objections over songs allegedly promoting alcohol consumption, last-minute police permissions and bomb threat emails that were later declared a hoax.

stories.title: How did Jaden Agassi step out of his famous parents' shadow? Meet Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf's son chas
stories.summary: Jaden Agassi grew up with one of the most famous surnames in tennis, but he has chosen a very different sport to build his career. The 25-year-old son of Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf has developed into a baseball pitcher, played college baseball at the University of Southern California (USC) and represented Germany in the 2025 World Baseball Classic qualifiers.

stories.title: Can someone else’s missed EMI damage your borrowing prospects? What happens to credit score after becoming a guarantor?
stories.summary: When you agree to become a loan guarantor, it may seem like a straightforward and simple favour to a family member or a friend. Still, what you should not overlook is the fact that it can have serious financial consequences if the borrower fails to meet their repayment obligations and clear out the loan on time.

stories.title: Can poor air quality raise your risk of pneumonia? Experts explain what keeps you protected and what doesn't
stories.summary: Exposure to polluted air, smoke and harmful particles can weaken the lungs' natural defence mechanisms, increasing vulnerability to respiratory infections such as pneumonia. Doctors highlight that children, older adults and people with existing health conditions need extra protection. Tavishi Dogra is a Deputy Chief Content Producer, Health & Wellness, at Hindustan Times.

stories.title: Square brackets and sleepless nights: What really happens inside a UN climate summit | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Every year, nearly 200 countries gather at the Conference of the Parties (COP), the annual meeting of the 1992 United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), to negotiate global action on limiting global warming. Discussions include mitigation (cutting emissions), adaptation, climate finance, loss and damage (support for countries already harmed by climate change), and carbon markets.

stories.title: Explained: What is a DNA-based vaccine - The Times of India
stories.summary: Referred to as third-generation vaccine, a DNA-based vaccine uses engineered DNA to induce a response against the virus. Apart from adults, data is also being collected on if the vaccine can be administered to children belonging to the age group of 12 to 18 years.

stories.title: What is forest bathing? How the Japanese practice encourages you to reconnect with nature
stories.summary: When was the last time you walked among trees without checking your phone, rushing to reach a destination or thinking about your next task? The Japanese practice of forest bathing invites you to slow down and experience nature with your full attention. Known as shinrin-yoku, it offers a simple way to step away from daily distractions and reconnect with the world around you.

stories.title: Why did the NFL make emergency officiating changes for Week 10? FAA ground stop forces last-minute refere
stories.summary: The NFL has made last-minute changes to its officiating assignments for Week 10 after Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop disrupted air travel across the United States. The league has reassigned officials to games they can reach by road, bringing three backup officials into referee roles for four Sunday matchups.

stories.title: Why Is November 14 Celebrated As Bal Diwas In India? Know Its Connection To Jawaharlal Nehru
stories.summary: Children's Day, also known as Bal Diwas, is celebrated in India every year on November 14. The day commemorates the birth anniversary of India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. He was famously known as Chacha Nehru. He was a strong advocate of children's rights and education. His idea of education for children was introducing inclusivity in education for the country to prosper.

stories.title: Thane: 20-year-old man drowns in lake while performing Chhath Puja rituals
stories.summary: A 20-year-old man drowned in a lake in Maharashtra's Thane city while participating in Chhath Puja rituals on Monday morning, officials said. Thane Municipal Corporation ‘s (TMC) disaster management chief, Yasin Tadvi , said that the incident occurred at a lake located inside the Mafatlal Compound, adjacent to the Kalwa railway station, as cited by PTI.

stories.title: CM Fadnavis attends Chhath Puja at Mumbai's Juhu beach
stories.summary: Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Sunday said Indian festivals play an important role in strengthening national unity by bringing together people from different communities and backgrounds. He was speaking at a Chhath Puja celebration organised at Juhu Beach in Mumbai, where thousands of devotees gathered to offer prayers to the setting Sun and seek the blessings of Chhathi Maiya.

stories.title: Dombivli youth drowns during Chhath Puja in Kalyan; body recovered after 13 hours

The incident occurred around 6 pm when, according to eyewitnesses, Jugnu entered a deeper section of the pond, apparently unaware of its depth.

stories.title: Census portal lists ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’ among 287 ‘other’ religions; removes menu later

stories.title: Srisailam witnesses pilgrim rush on occasion of Karthika Monday

Devotees thronged the Sri Bhramaramba Mallikarjuna Swamy temple, Mahanandi, Yaganti and other temples to have darshan of Lord Shiva. They lit the sacred lamps in the premises of the temples and offered special prayers as part of the occasion.

stories.title: Travancore Devaswom Board seeks Andhra Pradesh’s support for smooth Sabarimala pilgrimage
stories.summary: The Travancore Devaswom Board has made extensive arrangements for the annual Sabarimala pilgrimage season, which will continue for two months, its chairman K. Jayakumar has said. In a letter to Andhra Pradesh Chief Secretary G. Sai Prasad, Mr. Jayakumar said a large number of Ayyappa devotees from Andhra Pradesh visit Sabarimala every year and sought the State government’s cooperation in ensuring a smooth pilgrimage this season.

stories.title: Temple for PM Modi’s late mother to come up in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district
stories.summary: A temple dedicated to Heeraben Modi, the late mother of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, is being constructed in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district as a tribute to her, a charitable trust overseeing the project said on Monday, describing it as a symbol of a son’s reverence for his mother.

stories.title: Kalpathy witnesses grand meeting of temple chariots
stories.summary: Thousands of people from across the State and Tamil Nadu gathered at Kalpathy on Monday evening to witness the convergence of temple chariots, marking the finale of the annual car festival. 30 pm. The chariots represented the Viswanathaswamy Temple, Kalpathy; Manthakkara Sree Mahaganapathy Temple, New Kalpathy; Sree Lakshminarayana Perumal Temple, Old Kalpathy; and Sree Prasanna Mahaganapathy Temple, Chathapuram.
